cweCompare.note: totals = CVEs in the window with a CNA CWE id; 'all' = non-AI CVEs

evaluation.method: Stratified random sample of PUBLISHED CVE records, hand-labeled from description and affected product: 120 from records the matcher flagged, 110 from unflagged records hitting a broad AI-ish keyword net, 60 from all other unflagged records; precision and recall are estimated by weighting each stratum by its population size.
